skill.name: deep-research
skill.description: Run structured coding research through a configured Dify workflow and return analysis with implementation guidance.
skill.summary: Delegates coding research to Dify and returns analysis plus an implementation guide.
skill.author: 21pounder

security_audit.summary: The TypeScript backtick findings are mostly false positives from JavaScript template strings and Markdown formatting. The confirmed issues are the external Dify network call, automatic .env loading from parent or working directories, DIFY_API_KEY handling, and the workflow design that lets remote research output guide local implementation steps.

remediation.issue: Automatic .env discovery loads secrets from parent and working directories.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit configuration paths or only read approved environment variables from the current process. Do not search parent directories for .env files by default.

remediation.issue: Research requests and credentials are sent to a configurable external endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before sending task details externally, allowlist trusted Dify base URLs, and document what data is transmitted.

remediation.issue: Remote workflow output is used for dependency installation, file changes, environment setup, and verification commands.
remediation.suggestion: Require review of all generated commands and file edits before execution. Treat workflow output as untrusted content.

remediation.issue: The skill asks agents to run npx tsx from Bash.
remediation.suggestion: Pin runtime dependencies where possible and pass task arguments safely. Avoid executing generated commands from research output without approval.

content.value_statement: Complex coding research often requires checking docs, examples, and implementation tradeoffs. This skill sends a structured request to a Dify workflow and returns analysis plus an implementation guide.
actual_capabilities: Delegates coding research requests to a configured Dify workflow.
Accepts a coding task, optional technology stack, and research depth.
Streams Dify workflow events and returns the final analysis and guide.
Loads Dify API settings from environment variables or supported .env locations.
Parses task analysis text when the workflow returns a JSON-formatted analysis block.
limitations: Requires a valid Dify API key and reachable workflow endpoint.
Sends task details and technology context to the configured Dify service.
The quality of results depends on the external Dify workflow configuration.
Generated implementation steps still require human review before execution.

use_cases.title: Plan an unfamiliar integration
use_cases.description: Research required APIs, dependencies, setup steps, and common issues before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Compare technical options
use_cases.description: Collect structured evidence about libraries, frameworks, and tradeoffs for a design decision.

use_cases.title: Prepare implementation notes
use_cases.description: Create a guided summary of files, configuration, verification steps, and sources for a coding task.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Topic Research
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused coding topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research how to implement password reset emails in a Node.js application. Use a standard depth and include practical implementation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Stack-Aware Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Research adding real-time notifications to my app. The stack is React, TypeScript, Express, and PostgreSQL. Compare common implementation approaches.

prompt_templates.title: Migration Planning
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a larger change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research migrating a REST API to GraphQL for a production SaaS backend. Include risks, dependency choices, rollout strategy, and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Deep Architecture Research
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that needs broad evidence and implementation detail.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run comprehensive research on multi-tenant authorization for a B2B platform. Include data model options, security concerns, testing strategy, and source-backed recommendations.

output_examples.input: Research adding OAuth2 login to a Next.js application.
output_examples.output: The response summarizes the authentication flow, recommended libraries, required provider setup, files to modify, environment settings, verification steps, and source references.

output_examples.input: Research database query optimization for PostgreSQL and Prisma.
output_examples.output: The response identifies likely bottlenecks, indexing strategies, query inspection methods, implementation steps, testing guidance, and common issues to avoid.

output_examples.input: Research whether to use WebSockets or server-sent events for notifications.
output_examples.output: The response compares both options, explains operational tradeoffs, recommends an approach for the stated stack, and lists follow-up implementation steps.

best_practices: Provide the exact coding task, stack, constraints, and desired depth before running the workflow.
Review all generated dependency, file, environment, and command suggestions before applying them.
Confirm sources and test instructions against official documentation for production changes.
anti_patterns: Do not send confidential product details unless the configured Dify service is approved for that data.
Do not run generated install or verification commands without reviewing their purpose and scope.
Do not treat the generated guide as a substitute for local tests, code review, and security review.

faq.question: What does this skill need to run?
faq.answer: It needs Node tooling, the TypeScript client dependencies, and a Dify API key configured in the environment.

faq.question: Does it contact an external service?
faq.answer: Yes. It sends the research request to the configured Dify workflow endpoint.

faq.question: Can it implement the code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It returns research and implementation guidance that should be reviewed before changes are made.

faq.question: Can I control research depth?
faq.answer: Yes. The depth value is limited from 1 to 5 before the request is sent.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect task analysis, implementation guidance, dependencies, file guidance, environment notes, verification steps, gotchas, and sources.

faq.question: Is it safe for private codebases?
faq.answer: Use it only when the configured Dify service is approved for the project information you provide.
